claims.claim: bun run ai:doctor runs and prints a useful report

commands.notes: Prints repository name, commit, branch, dirty state, product maturity, current milestone, verified commands, authoritative paths, critical blockers, manifest freshness, and read-next pointers.

claims.claim: bun run ai:check runs and either passes (exit 0) or fails (exit 1) with specific drift messages

commands.notes: Runs 15 checks: README command existence, manifest validity, authority-map ranks, context-profiles required profiles, manifest SHA freshness, command verified-not-null, entrypoint paths, handoff path, shim byte-equality, schemas, hierarchical AGENTS.md, .gitignore patterns, handoff STATE.json, root PNG warning, handoff SHA match.

claims.claim: bun run ai:build runs and refreshes .ai/project.manifest.json provenance + command exit codes

commands.notes: Refreshes provenance (commit, branch, dirty, dirtyReason, generatedAt), refreshes commands (verified flag from package.json, expandsTo, lastRunExitCode for lint and typecheck). Preserves human-curated fields (milestone, blockers, ADRs, maturity).

claims.claim: Tool shims (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md) are byte-identical except for the first two lines
claims.notes: shimsMatch() reads each file, slices off the first two lines (title + tagline), and compares the rest byte-for-byte. All three shims were generated from the same template.

AGENTS.md is now ~110 lines (was 169). Contains: product, read-first, authority precedence, verified commands, hard rules, change discipline, required evidence, architectural boundaries, completion report format, where deeper information lives. Extended essays moved to docs/product/engineering-principles.md.
